title: 疑问句与否定句
goal: 能区分疑问词的句法作用，正确安排疑问句和否定句的助动词。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 写作

points.label: 正确放置助动词和否定词

body.p: 一般疑问句把 be、助动词或情态动词放在主语前。一般现在时和一般过去时的句子没有这类动词，就加 do、does 或 did，实义动词改用原形。

body.box:
The ferry departs at eight. → Does the ferry depart at eight?
The ferry was delayed. → Was the ferry delayed?

body.p: 特殊疑问句先看疑问词是不是主语。Who called the dispatcher? 中 who 是主语，不加 did。Who did the dispatcher call? 中 who 是宾语，要加 did。

cards.title: 疑问句语序
rows: be 放在主语前，不加 do。
do / does + 主语 + 动词原形。
过去时由 did 表示，实义动词用原形。
have / has + 主语 + 过去分词。
Has the captain checked the route?
情态动词 + 主语 + 原形。
疑问词在前，后面用一般疑问句的语序。
疑问词后面直接接谓语，不加 do。

cards.title: 助动词的选择
rows: 第三人称单数一般现在时用 does。
复数主语一般现在时用 do。
一般过去时的疑问句都用 did，主语单数复数一样。
Did this ticket include a meal?
be 跟主语一致，后面接现在分词。
have 跟主语一致，后面接过去分词。
have 表示拥有时，问句用 do / does。
Does the vessel have a lift?

cards.title: 否定词的位置
rows: not 放在 be 后面，不加 do。
do / does / did + not + 原形。
not 放在第一个助动词后面。
The tickets have not been printed.
情态动词后接 not，再接原形。
The vessel cannot enter the harbor.
缩写形式放在主语前，表示想确认或感到意外。
语序是助动词 + 主语 + not。
never 本身表示否定，不再加 not。
The ferry has never stopped here.

body.box:
The departure board still shows a delay.
Why did the ______ ______ ______ ______ ?
not / leave / train / on time / left

body.p: Why 问原因。已给的 did the 后面接名词 train。过去时由 did 表示，所以 leave 用原形。not 放在主语 train 后面。

body.box: Why did the train not leave on time?

body.p: 句子已有 did，再用 left 就把过去时表示了两次，所以 left 是多出的词块。on time 放在句末，not 不放进 on time 里。

items.stem: The cable car has several stops.
items.why: Does 后面先接主语，再接原形 stop，不用 stops。at the summit 是地点。

items.stem: The tram line changed last year.
items.why: When 后面是 did the route change。did 已经表示过去时，changed 多余。

items.stem: Someone has borrowed the station bicycle.
items.why: Who 是主语，后面直接接 has been using，不加 do。who 作主语时按单数算，所以不用 have。

items.stem: The shuttle is approaching the terminal.
items.why: Is 后面先接主语 the shuttle，再接现在分词 carrying。进行时不用原形 carry。

items.stem: Why are the luggage carts still here?
items.why: not 放在 has 后面，再接过去分词 moved。现在完成时不用原形 move。

items.stem: Why is the taxi meter blank?
items.why: does not 后接原形 have，不能用第三人称单数 has。

items.stem: Did the driver accept the route change?
items.why: did not 后面用原形 agree，不用 agreed。agree to it 表示同意这件事。

items.stem: The bus pass was supposed to be renewed.
items.why: 已给的 Has the 后面接 office，再接 not renewed。完成时不用原形 renew。

items.stem: The pedestrian gate seems narrow.
items.why: Can 后面先接主语 a wheelchair，再接原形 pass。情态动词后面不用 passes。

items.stem: The new elevator is still out of service.
items.why: Hasn't 放在主语前，主语后面接过去分词 replaced，构成否定疑问句。replace 多余。

items.stem: The harbor office requires a permit.
items.why: What 是 to do 的宾语，问句的主干是 does the permit allow。does 后面用原形，不用 allows。

items.stem: Why is the luggage locker still open?
items.why: door 后面用 is not locked，说明门没有锁上。is locking 表示门在锁别的东西，意思不对。

items.stem: The escalator has stopped.
items.why: Has 后面先接主语，再接过去分词 cut off 和宾语 the power。完成时不用 cuts。

items.stem: The express coach takes a different road.
items.why: Which road 是 use 的宾语，后面接 does the coach use。does 后面用原形，不用 uses。

items.stem: Several people helped unload the ferry.
items.why: Who 是主语，后面直接接 was in charge of。being 不能单独作谓语。

items.stem: The tow truck arrived after midnight.
items.why: When 后面是 did the operator receive。过去时由 did 表示，received 多余。

items.stem: The airfield has a grass runway.
items.why: Can 后面先接 small planes，再接原形 land，不用 lands。on that runway 是降落的地点。

items.stem: Why is the turnstile still open?
items.why: has not been activated 是现在完成时的被动。has 后面用 been，不用 being。

items.stem: Why did the moving van return?
items.why: could not 后面用原形 find。情态动词后面不用 found。

items.stem: I thought the terminal sold travel cards.
items.why: Doesn't 放在主语前，sell 用原形。说话人原以为这里卖票，所以用否定疑问句确认。

items.stem: The luggage carousel is still running.
items.why: Has the 后面接 last passenger，再接 not collected。完成时不用原形 collect。

items.stem: Did the customs desk close early?
items.why: did not 后面用原形 close，closed 多余。before six 说明没有在六点前关门。
